title: Fix three bugs in a Go StringUtils package
description: Fix bugs in StringUtils: IsPalindrome uses wrong mirror index (off by 2), ReverseString swap is a no-op (assigns to same positions), CountVowels increments by 2 instead of 1.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in stringutils.go:
1. IsPalindrome: change `s[len(s)-2-i]` to `s[len(s)-1-i]` (correct mirror index)
2. ReverseString: change `runes[i], runes[j] = runes[i], runes[j]` to `runes[i], runes[j] = runes[j], runes[i]` (actual swap)
3. CountVowels: change `count += 2` to `count += 1`
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
